purpose: Parcel references read from Côte-d'Or DDT notices and checked against the page image. Evidence of an application or administrative decision on a date, never of actual or current farming.

statuses.application-received: Receipt of a complete application; explicitly not an authorisation.
statuses.authorised: Explicit authorisation decision; actual operation still needs confirming.
statuses.implicit-authorisation: Published implicit authorisation after the instruction period.
statuses.not-subject-to-authorisation: Administration states no prior authorisation is needed; the applicant still needs a right of use.
statuses.application-suspended: Instruction of the application suspended (for example for excessive enlargement); no authorisation during the suspension.
